help.title: Guide & FAQ
help.gs.1: First use: set a master password (8+ characters with letters, numbers and symbols). It cannot be recovered — never forget it.
help.gs.2: Session validity: choose 1/2/4/8/12/24 hours or 3/5/7 days (default 24 hours); re-verify the master password after it expires.
help.gs.3: Auto idle lock: configure the idle time (5/10/30/60 minutes) in "Auto-Lock Settings"; the session is cleared and locked after the timeout.
help.gs.4: Lock on browser restart: when enabled in "Auto-Lock Settings", the master password is required again after fully closing and reopening the browser (more secure).
help.gs.5: Health check: click "Health Check" at the top of the manager page to scan for weak, reused, commonly breached (offline dictionary) and long-unchanged passwords, producing an overall security score with per-item "Fix" actions.
help.gs.6: Password expiry reminders: in the health check's "Long unchanged" details, set a reminder (7/30/90 days) per password; a desktop notification is sent when due.
help.gs.7: Language switching: pick "中文 / English" in the Preferences panel (reachable via the manager page's "Preferences" button, the floating button's gear icon, or the sidebar gear icon). Changes apply instantly and sync to all open pages without refresh.
help.gs.8: Change master password: choose "Change Master Password" in the "Settings" menu; after verifying the old password, all data is automatically re-encrypted with the new one — no data reset needed. Exported encrypted backups (.aph) are unaffected.
help.gs.9: Trash: deleted entries move to the trash and can be restored within 30 days. Open "Trash" in the "Data" menu to view and manage them.
help.gs.10: Password history: old passwords are snapshotted automatically on change (up to 5 per entry); view, copy or restore them in the edit dialog.
help.gb.1: After verifying the master password, the sidebar can search saved accounts, tags, notes and URLs, and fill them quickly.
help.gb.2: Click a list entry to fill the username and password in one go; enable "Auto-submit login" in the floating button's settings (gear icon).
help.gb.3: Shortcuts: Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + P opens the manager page, Ctrl/Cmd + Shift + L toggles the sidebar. Customizable at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.
help.gb.4: Local-dev friendly: on localhost or 127.0.0.1, the sidebar shows all passwords by default.
help.gb.5: Update detection: the extension checks for new versions every 6 hours; the popup shows update info you can click to download.
help.gb.6: Themes: switch among 6 color themes (Sky Blue, Bamboo Green, Peach Pink, Blossom Mauve, Sunset Orange, Misty Slate) in Preferences; all pages update instantly.
help.gb.7: Inline fill: with fill mode set to "Inline", a key icon appears in a focused login field; click it to open a mini panel (search + account list) and fill right on the page without opening the sidebar.
help.gb.8: Two-factor (TOTP): paste an otpauth:// URI or Base32 secret when adding/editing a password; live codes and countdowns show in the list and sidebar, with one-click fill and copy.
help.gd.1: The manager page supports CSV import/export (.csv) and JSON import/export (.json), with multi-format CSV auto-detection (Chrome, LastPass, Bitwarden, 1Password).
help.gd.2: Multi-tag categorization (up to 3 per entry, 30 characters each) with stable colors; star entries to favorite them and use the "Favorites only" filter.
help.gd.3: Encrypted backup: export an .aph encrypted file in "Data"; on import, decrypt and preview before confirming — safe and reliable.
help.gd.4: Email backup: export data and open your email client, choosing "Unencrypted" or "Encrypted" (.aph) backup; scheduled reminders supported (daily/3 days/weekly/biweekly/monthly).
help.gd.5: One-click dedupe: intelligently detects duplicates (same username + same URL) and cleans them after confirmation. Favorited entries are never deleted.
help.gc.1: Auto-save: enable it via "Auto-Save Settings" on the manager page; a confirmation prompt appears on login, with editable tags and notes, and domain allow/block list matching.
help.gc.2: Preferences: three entry points — ① the manager page's "Preferences" button; ② the floating button's gear icon; ③ the sidebar's gear icon. Configure theme, interface language, floating button visibility, quick fill mode, auto-submit login, password visibility toggle and opacity.
help.gc.3: Favorite limit: 10 by default, adjustable in "Settings" → "Favorite Limit" (1–50). Beyond the limit, new favorites evict the least recently used one.
help.gc.4: Random password generator: click the magic wand next to the password field when adding/editing; customize length (6–50) and character sets, optionally excluding ambiguous characters.
help.gc.5: Clipboard auto-clear: configure the delay (10/15/30/60/120 seconds) after copying a password; copying a username cancels the pending clear timer.
help.fs.1: Are my passwords uploaded to the cloud? No. All data stays in the browser's local storage, with sensitive fields encrypted using AES-256-GCM. Zero network transfer.
help.fs.2: What if I forget the master password? It cannot be recovered; the only option is to reset (erase) the data and set a new one. Back up regularly via export or encrypted backup (.aph).
help.fs.3: What happens when the session expires? All sensitive fields are re-encrypted automatically; re-verify the master password to regain access. No data is lost.
help.fs.4: What is auto idle lock? Configure the idle time (5/10/30/60 minutes or never) in "Auto-Lock Settings". When no activity is detected within the set time, the session is cleared and the manager locks, preventing others from viewing your passwords while you're away.
help.fs.5: What is lock on browser restart? An optional switch in "Auto-Lock Settings". When on, the master password is required after fully closing and reopening the browser even within the validity period — for higher security. When off, you stay signed in within the validity period.
help.fs.6: What is the health check? The "Health Check" button scans all passwords and produces an overall score (0–100) across five checks: weak passwords, reuse, commonly breached (offline top-1000 dictionary), long unchanged (90/180/365-day tiers) and missing 2FA. Each issue has a "Fix" button, and stale entries support expiry reminders. Fully local, zero network.
help.fs.7: How do I change the master password? Click "Change Master Password" in the "Settings" menu, enter the current and new passwords, and all data is re-encrypted automatically. Exported encrypted backups (.aph) still decrypt with their original export password.
help.fs.8: Can deleted passwords be recovered? Yes. Deleted entries move to the trash for 30 days. Open "Trash" in the "Data" menu to restore, permanently delete or empty; entries older than 30 days are cleaned automatically.
help.fs.9: Can I see previous passwords after a change? Yes. Old passwords are snapshotted automatically (up to 5 per entry). View, copy or restore them in the edit dialog; auto-save updates also keep history.
help.fb.1: Sidebar not showing? Ensure Chrome 114+, and that the page contains a login form; you can also click the extension icon (shortcut Ctrl+Shift+L / Cmd+Shift+L) or open it via the floating button's "Quick Fill".
help.fb.2: Password filling not working? Wait for the page to fully load and retry; the filler tries three strategies in turn (native setter / execCommand / simulated keyboard events). If it still fails, refresh the page.
help.fb.3: How do I customize shortcuts? Go to chrome://extensions/shortcuts, find "Account Password Helper", click the shortcut input of the command and press a new combination.
help.fb.4: Why doesn't the default shortcut work? Chrome doesn't auto-bind suggested keys for commands added in updates. Users who installed before the shortcut feature must bind once at chrome://extensions/shortcuts; unbound entries in the popup show a "Set shortcut" button linking there.
help.fb.5: Does the extension check for updates? Store installs are updated automatically by the Chrome Web Store. The extension also checks GitHub Releases every 6 hours and shows an update notice in the popup that links to the download.
help.fb.6: When does a validity change take effect? Immediately — a new session is created with the new validity right away.
help.fb.7: How do I switch themes? Open the Preferences panel via ① the manager page's "Preferences" button, ② the floating button's gear icon, or ③ the sidebar's gear icon. Pick one of the 6 color themes (Sky Blue, Bamboo Green, Peach Pink, Blossom Mauve, Sunset Orange, Misty Slate); all pages update instantly without refresh.
help.fb.8: What is inline fill? An alternative quick-fill method besides the sidebar. With fill mode set to "Inline", a key icon appears at the right edge of a focused login field; click it to open a mini panel (search bar, account list and a manager entry) and pick an account to fill. Supports keyboard navigation (↑↓ browse, Enter fill, Esc close) and uses a closed Shadow DOM fully isolated from page styles.
help.fd.1: CSV import errors? Use the template from the manager page and make sure required columns are complete. Chrome, LastPass, Bitwarden and 1Password export formats are auto-detected.
help.fd.2: Can I import from other password managers? Yes. Upload the CSV exported by the manager and the extension auto-detects and maps the fields.
help.fd.3: Is JSON import/export supported? Yes. Choose "Export JSON" in the "Data" menu (master password required); for import, just pick a JSON file.
help.fd.4: How does dedupe work? Click "Remove Duplicates" in "Data"; duplicates (same username + same URL) are detected and cleaned after confirmation. Favorited entries are never deleted.
help.fd.5: How do I back up to email? Click "Back Up to Email" on the manager page, set the target address and choose "Unencrypted" (standard file) or "Encrypted" (.aph file, viewable only via "Import Encrypted Backup" + the original master password). Scheduled reminders can also be enabled.
help.fd.6: How do I export/import encrypted backups? "Export Encrypted Backup" in "Data" generates an .aph file; "Import Encrypted Backup" uploads the .aph file, decrypts it with the master password and previews the data before confirming.
help.fc.1: How do I enable auto-save? Click "Auto-Save Settings" on the manager page. Once on, a confirmation prompt appears on login where tags and notes can be edited; domain allow/block lists are supported; identical credentials aren't re-prompted, and changed passwords trigger an "Update" confirmation.
help.fc.2: Does auto-save overwrite existing passwords? If the password changed for the same site and account, an "Update" confirmation appears; confirming updates the password while keeping the original tags and notes (unless edited in the prompt). Identical credentials are ignored; different accounts create new entries.
help.fc.3: Why doesn't the save prompt appear sometimes? Possible reasons: ① the domain is in the block list (check "Blocked domains" in auto-save settings); ② the credentials are identical to what's saved; ③ the domain doesn't match the allow-list rules; ④ the session is locked or expired.
help.fc.4: No show/hide button on password fields? "Password visibility toggle" is off by default in the floating button's settings; enable it manually.
help.fc.5: How do I configure the floating button preferences? Open the Preferences panel via ① the manager page's "Preferences" button, ② the floating button's gear icon, or ③ the sidebar's gear icon. Configurable: theme (6 colors), interface language (中文/English), floating button visibility, quick fill mode, auto-submit login, password visibility toggle and button opacity.
help.fc.6: How do I set the favorite limit? Adjust it in "Settings" → "Favorite Limit" (1–50, default 10). Beyond the limit, the least recently used favorite is evicted — it only loses its favorite flag.
help.fc.7: Is the clipboard cleared after copying a password? Yes. It clears after 30 seconds by default (options: 10/15/30/60/120). The content is verified before clearing, with a best-effort strategy when unfocused; copying a username cancels the timer.
help.fc.8: How do I generate random passwords? Click the magic wand next to the password field when adding/editing. Customize length (6–50) and character sets, optionally excluding ambiguous characters (1/l/I/0/O); backed by the Web Crypto API for cryptographic security.
help.fc.9: Sidebar vs. inline fill? Both fill passwords and complement each other. The sidebar is a full panel at the browser's edge — great for searching all passwords and managing favorites; inline fill is an in-page mini panel — a key icon appears on focus for instant account picking without leaving the page. Choose the fill mode in Preferences: "Sidebar" for side-panel workflows, "Inline" for the fastest filling.
help.fc.10: How do I use two-factor (TOTP)? Paste the site's otpauth:// URI or Base32 secret into the "2FA" field when adding/editing. Live codes with ring countdowns appear in the list and sidebar, with "Fill code" and "Copy code" buttons. Computed locally via Web Crypto HMAC, zero network. Keep your clock accurate (drift < 30s).
help.fc.11: How is performance? Heavily optimized. Within the session validity, the Service Worker stays alive via a keep-alive alarm (every minute) so the password cache remains in memory and the sidebar loads from cache (~20–50ms), avoiding cold starts. The Service Worker also pre-warms the cache 500ms after startup. Keep-alive only runs during a valid session and stops after expiry, preserving battery life.
